Find the opening hours of the National Museum in Delhi and the ticket price
9:57 PM

The National Museum (Janpath, New Delhi) is open Tue to Fri, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and Sat and Sun, 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM. It is closed on Mondays and national holidays, so tomorrow, Fri 13 Nov, it is open 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

Entry is ₹20 for adults and ₹500 for foreign nationals. Students up to class 12 get in free with an ID card.

The museum's own page says you can book tickets online at https://www.zoonga.com/national-museum. This comes from the museum's official site, which does not show when it was last updated. Check the holiday calendar there before you go.
